## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Condo price analysis in Cambodia)—Market analysis and modeling of condominium sale prices in Cambodian urban markets.

## Problem & Data

Condo investors require comparable unit pricing adjusted for floor, size, district, and amenities.

## Approach

Listing aggregation, feature engineering for unit attributes, EDA, and predictive modeling.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

District-level price insights and model-based valuation estimates.
